name: Alien Buster
description: Alien Buster is an action-packed, arcade-style shooter where players take on the role of an elite space defender tasked with protecting Earth from waves of alien invaders. Armed with advanced weapons and power-ups, players must blast through endless enemies, dodge obstacles, and face challenging boss fights. With fast-paced gameplay and increasing difficulty, Alien Buster offers an adrenaline-filled experience that tests reflexes and strategy.
